papers.title: Torsional and axial tension/compression fatigue behavior of Ti-6Al-4V diamond lattices produced by Laser Powder Bed Fusion (LPBF)
papers.abstract: The increasing importance to characterize additively manufactured lattice structures in different load regimes cannot be overemphasized due to their robust load bearing applications in lightweight structural parts or biomedical implants. This study investigates the torsional fatigue behavior of metallic diamond cell structures to check the mean stress sensitivity of these meta-materials. Consistency in results for torsional fatigue is achieved by a unique sample design that minimizes stress concentration, is self-centering and graded. In addition, axial fatigue in tension–tension, compression–compression and tension–compression is studied. The tensile mode is found to be most detrimental to fatigue life of all axial modes. An analytical local stress method (LSM) is presented to estimate the maximum local stresses that occur in the structure. By using this approach, axial tension/compression and torsion fatigue experiments almost fall together due to the similar maximum local stress. Reverse calculations from these local stress curves can provide valuable insight into torsional strength when data are available only for axial fatigue tests. • Unique sample design to provide consistent results under torsional loads. • Fatigue life normalization model for different relative density and load regimes. • Macro and micro-scale correlative fractographic analysis of lattices.

llm.relevance_to_user: 本文研究了LPBF制造的Ti-6Al-4V金刚石点阵结构的扭转和轴向疲劳行为，属于L1层核心内容。
llm.why_not_core: Focuses on lattice structures rather than bulk Ti-6Al-4V mechanical properties; no parametric study of process variables or anisotropy.

summary_zh.motivation: 表征LPBF Ti-6Al-4V点阵结构的扭转疲劳性能
summary_zh.method: 设计独特试样进行扭转和轴向疲劳试验，并提出局部应力法
summary_zh.result: 拉伸模式对疲劳寿命最不利，局部应力法可统一不同载荷模式数据
summary_zh.validation: 通过扭转和轴向疲劳试验及断口分析验证

summary_en.motivation: The study aims to characterize the torsional fatigue behavior of additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V diamond lattice structures for load-bearing applications.
summary_en.method: A unique sample design minimizes stress concentration and enables consistent torsional fatigue testing; axial tension/compression tests and an analytical local stress method (LSM) are also employed.
summary_en.result: Tensile loading is most detrimental to fatigue life, and the local stress method collapses axial and torsional fatigue data onto a single curve.
summary_en.validation: Experimental fatigue tests under various loading modes combined with fractographic analysis validate the findings.

papers.title: An Experimental Investigation of the Shape Deviation of SLM Printed Parts
papers.abstract: The 3D printing technology is increasingly used in manufacturing, medicine, education, and various other fields. This technology allows for the creation of parts with complex shapes, which would be difficult or even impossible to manufacture using traditional machining methods. However, the quality of the printed products is still a barrier to the widespread use of the 3D printing technology in industrial applications. The former includes the accuracy of the shape, size, and mechanical properties of the printed products. Research to improve the efficiency of the printing process and the printed product quality is essential for application fields. This study, through experiments, determines the relationship between the shape deviation of the printed products and the set of printing parameters. The latter includes the laser power, printing speed, and printing layer thickness. Experimental studies were conducted on the FF-M180D printer using the Selective Laser Melting (SLM) printing method. Ti6Al4V powder is utilized as printing material for this study. Based on the regression model showing the relationship between the printing parameters and shape deviation, the optimal set of parameters to minimize the shape deviation was determined.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究SLM打印参数对Ti6Al4V零件形状偏差的影响，不涉及任何后处理工艺，因此与用户关注的后处理对疲劳/力学性能的影响无关。
llm.why_not_core: No post-processing treatment is studied; the paper focuses on as-built shape deviation from printing parameters, which belongs to Layer 1 process optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究SLM打印参数对Ti6Al4V零件形状偏差的影响
summary_zh.method: 通过实验建立回归模型，分析激光功率、速度、层厚对形状偏差的关系
summary_zh.result: 确定了最优打印参数组合以最小化形状偏差
summary_zh.validation: 实验测量形状偏差，回归模型验证

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the influence of SLM printing parameters on the shape deviation of Ti6Al4V parts.
summary_en.method: Experimental regression modeling relating laser power, scanning speed, and layer thickness to shape deviation.
summary_en.result: An optimal set of printing parameters was determined to minimize shape deviation.
summary_en.validation: Experimental measurement of shape deviation validated the regression model.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究的是Ti-6Al-4V的车削加工，不涉及增材制造，因此与用户关注的增材制造Ti-6Al-4V力学与疲劳性能无关。
llm.why_not_core: The paper investigates turning (subtractive machining) of Ti-6Al-4V, not additive manufacturing (LPBF/EBM/DED), and thus does not address AM process-structure-property relationships or fatigue behavior of AM Ti-6Al-4V.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究车削参数和冷却条件对Ti-6Al-4V表面粗糙度和刀具磨损的影响
summary_zh.method: 采用全因子实验设计在普通车床上进行Ti-6Al-4V车削实验
summary_zh.result: 切削速度和冷却条件对表面粗糙度和刀具磨损有显著影响
summary_zh.validation: 通过实测表面粗糙度和刀具磨损数据进行验证

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effects of cutting parameters and cooling conditions on surface roughness and tool wear during turning of Ti-6Al-4V alloy.
summary_en.method: A full factorial experimental design was employed on an all-gear lathe to conduct turning experiments on Ti-6Al-4V.
summary_en.result: Cutting speed and cooling condition significantly influence surface roughness and tool wear.
summary_en.validation: Experimental measurements of surface roughness and tool wear were used for validation.
